player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Utility room and the Study room, repeatedly going north and then south. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to continue exploring the same rooms instead of recognizing that I had already visited them. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have visited and avoid revisiting them. I will also try to explore other rooms that I haven't visited yet, such as the Library and the Wine cellar. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead of going back to a familiar room.
